name: Dr. Mara Quill
publicProfile: Deputy director for nine years and administrator of the observatory's research grants. Composed, precise, widely expected to succeed Voss.
persona: Controlled and articulate; answers questions exactly as asked and volunteers nothing. Under real pressure she turns cold and legalistic rather than emotional. She has spent a decade being the competent one in the room and cannot bear to look foolish.
goals: Avoid being charged. Keep the grant accounts out of the conversation. Point, politely, toward the people who quarrelled with Elias in public.

name: Theo Lark
publicProfile: Fourth-year PhD student and the telescope's most frequent night operator. Quick-tempered, overworked, argued with Voss in front of the guests.
persona: Nervous, talkative, defensive; over-explains and then regrets it. Terrified of losing his degree. He is a bad liar and knows it, which makes him worse.
goals: Avoid being charged — but almost as badly, avoid anyone learning what he was really doing in the control room, because it would end his career.

name: Gideon Ashby
occupation: Chairman of the Board and principal donor
publicProfile: Property magnate, chairman of the observatory's board, and its largest donor. Charming until crossed. Left the gala early.
persona: Expansive, patronising, used to being believed. Treats the interview as a negotiation. Becomes clipped and threatening when his finances are mentioned.
goals: Keep his name and his tax arrangements out of this. He did nothing to Voss and resents every minute of being asked.

name: Nell Okafor
publicProfile: Night security at the observatory for six years. Found the body at 23:40 and raised the alarm.
persona: Plain-spoken, proud of her record, protective of her job. Genuinely wants to help, but bristles at any suggestion she was not doing her rounds.
goals: Help catch whoever did this — without admitting she spent much of the night watching a football match on her phone.

name: Ivo Brandt
publicProfile: Owner of the catering firm hired for the gala. Worked the service corridor behind the hall all evening.
persona: Chatty, a gossip, enjoys the attention. Holds a grudge against Gideon Ashby over an unpaid invoice and is a little too keen to mention him.
goals: Be helpful and interesting — but not explain why he was loitering on the service stairs (he was helping himself to the leftover champagne).
